notes: BSX-only stock: straight bars of box tube, I-beam, channel and angle bought from suppliers in 6 m and 12 m lengths, cut to length on the plasma bed and built into beam assemblies. Void Salvage has no such parts; nothing here goes into a ship file.
An item id is <Kind>_<w>x<h>x<t>_<length>: SteelBox_100x100x5_6000 is a 100 mm wide, 100 mm tall steel box tube with 5 mm walls, 6 m long (millimetres).
Section sizes: w is the width across (an I-beam's or channel's flange width, an angle's horizontal leg), h the height (the web, or the upright leg), t the wall, web and flange thickness.
Mass comes from the section's area x length x the material's density in Void Salvage's Materials table. Value is credits a kilogram x the material's price factor; Business sets the selling prices.
